title: Launch train 1:1 prep notes
body:
Purpose: quick scratchpad for my 1:1 with release train leads (Thu sync + Friday go/no-go). I want this to be a lightweight list we can triage in 10-15m and leave with clear owners. Not a polished doc — rough, will convert to proper runbook if anything changes.

High-level: ship window Friday 09:00 UTC. Targeted services: hosted-api v2.7, dedicated autoscaler tweak, console rollout flags. Main risk buckets: infra capacity, DB migration, model bundle integrity, observability gaps.

Open questions to ask Leads:
- Infra: confirmed slot counts for dedicated pools in us-west-2 for peak? (Jonah)
- SRE: chaos drills or rollbacks tested since last canary? any new flake post-canary? (Marco)
- QA: are the critical path end-to-end prompts passing? any flaky tests masked by mocks? (Priya)
- Product: is feature gate schedule final? are we notifying beta customers? (PM: Tara)

Quick status bullets (as of this morning):
- Canary: low error-rate on text-gen flows (0.4% 5xx), latency median 112ms — trending stable.
- Migrations: user-metadata migration staged on staging, dry-run ok but not full-volume tested.
- Infra: 3 extra GPU nodes reserved but autoscaler config not hot-tested.
- Observability: trace sampling increased, but long-tail traces missing for 2 endpoints.
- Docs/comms: customer-facing note drafted, waiting PM sign-off.

Notes for the 1:1 agenda:
1) 3 quick wins (5m): confirm owners + blockers
2) Go/no-go checklist review (8m): walk each line and call OK / NOT OK
3) Contingency and rollback review (5m)
4) Final owner confirmations + communication plan (2m)

Tone: aggressive about blocking items, but pragmatic. If any single critical safety item is unknown, default to HOLD and escalate.

Misc scratch thoughts:
- If migration volume > 10k users in first hour, fallback plan B should be to disable non-essential background jobs (flag: background-lambdas).
- Consider a short post-mortem rubric template in the slack thread to capture quick post-launch notes (3 bullets: what, impact, next-step).

I will convert this to a cleaned checklist after 1:1 and post to the release-rail thread.
action_items: Jonah Reed - validate dedicated pool slot counts in us-west-2 and confirm reserved nodes - due 2026-03-11
Priya Singh - run full volume E2E on staging for metadata migration, capture flaky cases - due 2026-03-11
Marco Alvarez - execute autoscaler smoke test (scale down/up) and attach logs to REL-3490 - due 2026-03-11
Tara Mills (PM) - sign off customer communication draft and list beta customers to notify - due 2026-03-11
Elena Park - prepare go/no-go summary doc and post to #release-rail prior to Friday checkpoint - due 2026-03-12
go_no_go_checklist: Canary metrics within SLOs (error rate < 1%, p95 latency < 250ms) - OWNER: Jonah - STATUS: pending final 24h window
DB migration dry-run success at scale (>= production-like traffic) - OWNER: Priya - STATUS: partial (needs full-volume)
Autoscaler validated for burst and drain behavior - OWNER: Marco - STATUS: pending
Rollback plan documented and tested (hot-path rollback + feature gate flip) - OWNER: Elena - STATUS: ready
Runbook and on-call rotations published with paging details - OWNER: SRE lead - STATUS: needs confirmation
Customer comms ready and legal OK (data implications) - OWNER: Tara - STATUS: draft
